Replacing a ceiling fan capacitor

If your ceiling fan spins slowly or not at all, the run capacitor has likely failed. This guide walks through a safe replacement for common Pakistani ceiling fan models rated between 2.0uF and 2.5uF.

Error code: F3 may also appear on fans with an electronic display.

  1. Switch off the fan and the breaker for the room.
  2. Open the canopy cover at the top of the fan.
  3. Identify the black capacitor box near the motor windings.
  4. Discharge the capacitor before touching its terminals.
  5. Replace it with a capacitor of the same microfarad rating.

Always confirm the breaker is off with a tester before starting.
